Geo-Tagged Photo & Image Reuse AI

AI cross-checks on-site photographs against recorded project GPS coordinates, historical evidence databases across all projects, and timeline records to detect location mismatches and reused evidence.

Project Record Source — MPLADS SATHI Database & Image Hashing Engine

Verification results are analytical estimations using Haversine GPS distance algorithms, SHA-256 file hashing, and 64-bit perceptual image fingerprinting. Flags are labeled as "Potentially Reused Evidence" or "Location Mismatch" to guide field inspections without making automated fraud assertions.
